verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents a REST API at https://www.zohoapis.com/books/v3 with a stated goal of web-client parity, covering contacts, organizations and banking/reconciliation endpoints. It also documents OAuth 2.0 with a scopes catalog and published rate limits, and offers a downloadable OpenAPI corpus (live-verified), so an agent can drive the product programmatically. The probe 404s only show the spec isn't at generic well-known paths; it is published at a documented location. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that API calls work as documented end to end.
